scientific_integrity: An exact first-order weak-reset sign classification for mean and variance; analytic recurrence and monotonicity proof, with a symbolic and independent Laplace-transform checker. The general renewal transform and mean threshold are established prior results, not new.
scientific_limitations: Bounded absorbing ball, complete instantaneous resets to one fixed starting point, and one-sided reset-rate derivatives at zero only. Boundary cases have zero first derivative without a higher-order claim. Global optimal resetting and independent validation are not established. Implicit prior coverage through exact transforms remains a priority risk.
title: A sharp mean–variance conflict shell for weakly reset Brownian escape from a ball
